import.title: Import devices
import.description: Upload a file and map its columns to create or update devices in bulk.

import.uploadHint: CSV, XLSX and XLS files up to 10 MB.
import.templateHint: First import? Start with the example template.
import.excelSheet: The first worksheet "{name}" will be imported, preserving displayed cell values.
import.headerHint: Standard names such as NAME and TYPE are matched automatically. Other columns default to server attributes.
import.update: Update existing device attributes and telemetry
import.updateHint: Basic details of devices with matching names are updated. Enable this to also write their attributes and telemetry.
import.mappingHint: Device name and device profile columns are required.

validation.empty: The file has no data to import. Check that it contains more than a header.
validation.invalidFile: Choose a CSV, XLSX or XLS file.
validation.tooLarge: The file must be no larger than 10 MB.
validation.rowWidth: Row {row} has a different number of columns. Check the file and delimiter.
validation.format: Unable to read or parse the file. Check its format, quotes and delimiter.
validation.oneFile: Choose one file at a time.
validation.requiredColumns: Map exactly one device name column and one device profile column.
validation.requiredKey: Enter a key for every attribute and telemetry column.
validation.duplicateColumn: Duplicate column types or attribute / telemetry keys within the same scope. Check the mapping.

desc.telemetryPublish: Upload telemetry data to the server
desc.attributesPublish: Upload client-side attributes to the server
desc.attributesSubscribe: Subscribe to shared attribute updates from the server
desc.attributesRequest: Request client-side and shared attributes from the server
desc.attributesResponse: Receive the response of an attribute request
desc.attributesGet: Query client-side and shared attributes (clientKeys / sharedKeys)
desc.attributesUpdates: Long-poll for shared attribute updates (timeout in ms)
desc.serverRpcReply: Reply to a server-side RPC request
desc.clientRpcRequest: Send a client-side RPC request to the server
desc.clientRpcResponse: Receive the response of a client-side RPC request
desc.claim: Claim the device on behalf of a customer
desc.provisionResponse: Receive the provisioning result (including the access token)
desc.fwSubscribe: Subscribe to firmware chunks pushed by the server
desc.fwRequest: Request firmware content chunk by chunk
desc.swSubscribe: Subscribe to software chunks pushed by the server
desc.swRequest: Request software content chunk by chunk
desc.fwDownload: Download the firmware package (title / version come from shared attributes)
desc.swDownload: Download the software package (title / version come from shared attributes)
desc.gatewayConnect: Report that a sub-device is connected
desc.gatewayDisconnect: Report that a sub-device is disconnected
desc.gatewayAttributesSubscribe: Subscribe to shared attribute updates of sub-devices
desc.gatewayAttributesRequest: Request client-side or shared attributes of a sub-device
desc.gatewayAttributesResponse: Receive the response of a sub-device attribute request
desc.gatewayRpcSubscribe: Subscribe to server-side RPC requests addressed to sub-devices
desc.gatewayRpcReply: Reply to a server-side RPC request addressed to a sub-device
